close_reason: Done in 8fafffb. Added JmapClient::call_session(session, req) that reads session.api_url internally — wrong-URL-field mistake impossible. Additive (call(&str, &req) unchanged). Routing-correctness test via wiremock with upload_url etc. pointing at UNMOCKED path. Followup bd:JMAP-6r7c.64 tracks the same pattern for upload_blob/download_blob/subscribe_events.
description:
client.rs:304 — pub async fn call(&self, api_url: &str, req: &JmapRequest) -> ...

The function takes api_url as a bare &str. The doc-comment explains:
"api_url is taken as an explicit parameter (not from self) because the caller holds a Session and selects the correct URL from it."

That choice makes sense for the foundation-client design (the JmapClient doesn't own a Session because session can be re-fetched, swapped, etc.). But the API forces every caller to write:

  client.call(&session.api_url, &req).await?

…and gives them no help if they pass session.upload_url, session.download_url, or session.event_source_url by mistake. The mistake is silent at the type level. At runtime, posting a JSON body to the upload URL endpoint produces an HTTP-level error from the server — which surfaces as ClientError::Http with whatever status the server returned. A caller debugging an integration cannot quickly tell that the bug is "wrong URL", not "server is broken".

The defensive shape would be:

  pub async fn call(&self, session: &Session, req: &JmapRequest) -> Result<...>

…where session.api_url is read internally. The minor cost: the caller must hold a Session before calling. The major benefit: the wrong-URL bug becomes impossible.

Same logic applies to upload_blob (takes upload_url_template) and download_blob (takes download_url_template via DownloadBlobParams).

Workaround for now: type-check at the call site by writing `client.call(&session.api_url, &req)` consistently. A grep over downstream code can audit this — but every new caller is one rebase from getting it wrong.

Recommendation: in the next minor release, ADD a Session-taking variant alongside the existing &str variant. E.g.:
  pub async fn call_session(&self, session: &Session, req: &JmapRequest)
  -> Result<JmapResponse, ClientError>

The current call() stays for backward compat. New code uses the Session-taking variant.
title: JmapClient::call takes api_url as &str — caller must remember to use session.api_url not session.upload_url
